description: This file defines classes related to grain type bindings in the Orleans framework, including 'GrainBindings' to hold binding details and 'GrainBindingsResolver' to resolve and retrieve bindings for grain types, incorporating caching and concurrency control.

classes.name: GrainBindings
classes.description: Holds the bindings for a specific grain type, including the grain type itself and its associated binding dictionaries.

classes.name: GrainBindingsResolver
classes.description: Provides functionality to resolve, cache, and retrieve grain type bindings with concurrency control, handling both specific and generic grain types.

methods.name: GetBindings
methods.description: Returns the bindings associated with a specific grain type, utilizing cache and resolving generics.

methods.name: GetAllBindings
methods.description: Returns all grain bindings along with their version.

methods.name: BuildCache
methods.description: Constructs a cache of grain bindings by iterating over cluster manifest data.

methods.name: TryExtractBindingProperty
methods.description: Extracts binding property details from key-value pairs if they match the expected binding key pattern.
